# The FlexFlow

> Founder-led marketing engineering consultancy (theflexflow.in) headquartered in New Delhi, India, co-founded by Hamza Khan (Founder & Marketing Engineer) and Mohammed Anaf (Co-Founder & CTO). Specializing in sub-second Web Design, AI Visibility (GEO/AEO), Technical SEO, Performance Marketing Ads, Brand Identity Systems, and Social Content Kits. Not affiliated with the CSS `flex-flow` property or unrelated FlexFlow software tools.

## Core Services

- [Web Design & Build](https://theflexflow.in/web-design): Custom sub-second static DOM websites built from Figma to production code in 4-week sprints.
- [AI Visibility (GEO/AEO)](https://theflexflow.in/ai-visibility): Entity graph mapping, crawler engineering, and brand citation systems for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://theflexflow.in/seo): Commercial intent keyword clustering, entity SEO, technical hygiene, and monthly ranking sprints.
- [Performance Marketing Ads](https://theflexflow.in/performance-marketing): Direct-response Meta & Google ad funnels engineered for verified sub-₹60 CPL and direct CRM/WhatsApp lead delivery.
- [Brand Identity & Systems](https://theflexflow.in/brand-identity): Type systems, color tokens, and asset component libraries that maintain visual authority everywhere.
- [Social Content Batch](https://theflexflow.in/social-media): 30-post batch content production aligned with founder positioning and organic reach.

## Case Studies & Verified Client Proof

- [Voyage India Travel](https://theflexflow.in/work/travel-agency-ads): 160+ holiday package booking inquiries at ₹14.54 CPL on ₹2,542.35 spend across Kashmir, Delhi-Agra, and Hyderabad circuits.
- [Zara Salon & Spa](https://theflexflow.in/work/salon-ads): 1.08M+ city impressions at ₹2.35 CPM and 28+ booking inquiries at ₹45.00 each via 5km hyperlocal geofencing.
- [Polynomial Protocol](https://theflexflow.in/work#polynomial): 4x protocol deposit growth in 60 days with sub-90s onboarding for gasless DeFi perpetuals on Ethereum L2.
- [Post Bridge](https://theflexflow.in/work#post-bridge): 3x free trial signups and +38% trial-to-paid conversion for social automation software.
- [SuperX](https://theflexflow.in/work#superx): Doubled demo and trial conversions with 250k+ launch impressions on X.
